events.n: produced under Matisse’s supervision for a special issue of Verve
events.q: Nu Bleu, La Grenouille (Blue Nude, The Frog) was produced under Matisse’s supervision for a special issue of Verve (Les Dernieres Oeuvres de Matisse) which was dedicated to Matisse’s paper cut-outs

events.n: published after Matisse's death, as a tribute to him
events.q: As Matisse died before the work was published in 1958, the volume then became a tribute to Matisse
